notes.title: Fruit Factory Fall Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633777/5f8a4aa96aa237ff6a3119f0062f2d64a8fcec74.png[/img]
In honor of Thanksgiving and the Fall Steam Sale, Fruit Factory has a completely free new update!

[olist]
[*] New QOL keyboard shortcuts (with laptop compatible control scheme)
[*] Steam achievements
[*] Four new fall levels in the city
[*] New fall fruits (err.. pumpkins) to sort
[*] Additional bonus juice and interactions with background objects and extras
[/olist]

The game is also on sale for 33% off right now!
